Phase 10 is complete and Phase 11 is running live. Summary:

**Closed governance items 30/31/32** (bounded AI-model supervision-by-logging):
- compliance-tracker PR [#551](https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/551): added `logAiSupervisionEvent()`/`supervisionHash()` (llm-client.ts) + `callLLMWithSupervision()` (mother-router.ts) — logs `{model, prompt_hash, ts}` before and `{response_summary_hash, success}` after any Mother-Router-dispatched call, via `superboss-register.py log-action`. Explicitly scoped as logging-only, not intervention.
- Proved live (not dead code): real action rows `ACT-20260723-162104-aadb`/`-93fa`.
- Updated `ai-os/GOVERNANCE_AUDIT_RESULT_2026-07-23.yaml` items 30/31/32 → DONE, pulled from its true canonical branch (phase 9's, unmerged to master — the single-source-of-truth rule caught a real staleness gap).

**Honest limitation surfaced**: `task-gateway.py close` genuinely failed — this task's own SUCCESS_CRITERIA was written as prose, not a literal shell command, so it can never satisfy the tool's verbatim-runnable-command rule. Logged for whoever authors future phase prompts.

**Phase 11 dispatched and running**: re-verified items 21/24 are still Owner-blocked (no `adm` group grant), but found item 29 already fixed live on the host (unreported). Phase 11 will formally verify and close it. Its dispatch also hit — and I fixed — the same CONSTRAINTS/SCOPE contradiction-detector false-positive this task itself hit twice; Phase 11's SUCCESS_CRITERIA is written as an actual runnable command this time.
